status: registered before any v0.7 model run
question: With the same v0.7 code, does a run that starts from the v0.6 lessons ledger beat a run with an empty ledger on cost and speed without losing quality, and does v0.7 produce off-page findings that are backed by evidence?
changes: research_offpage: reads at most 4 off-site pages per run, only URLs listed by this run's search results (same host exactly), robots.txt respected, same-host or www. redirects only, public IPs only (checked again on the connected socket); returns links to the target (URL, anchor, rel) and short mention contexts, not page text; research_evidence returns only query excerpts of off-site snapshots
HTTP: Accept-Encoding identity; gzip/deflate bodies are decoded within the size cap, truncated streams are refused
research_search results carry host and is_target_host; research_fetch returns outbound_hosts (outbound links, never backlinks)
report claims carry section on_page/off_page/other; research_finish requires at least one on_page and one off_page claim; report.md groups each section into known / inferred / unknown

lesson statements are rendered at presentation as actions; discovery paths give the controller's current-run evidence_id and drop past findings (sitemap counts, anchor text); human review shows as a standard to apply
prompt: lessons are procedures; a verified page is current-run evidence to read, not to re-fetch
scoring: sitemap_reads, refetched_verified_pages, sections, off-page known counts, off-page policy audit; blind review adds 0-2 coverage scores on four dimensions

v06_reference.note: v0.6 scores use v0.6 code and are not compared with v0.7 runs

ledger_source.note: The ledger after v0.6 R3, unchanged since (R3 and HM were frozen). R4 must start before usable_until, or its discovery lessons will have expired and a new plan is needed.

holdout.rule: The v0.6 registered holdout ranking (evaluation/plan-v06.json), without icasino.tw, which v0.6 HB and HM already researched. Rank 1 is the holdout; rank 2 is the fallback if preflight fails.
holdout.preflight: Step HP2 fetches robots.txt and the homepage of the primary with the controller only; if robots.txt is not 200/404/410, robots disallows the homepage, or the homepage is not HTTP 200, the fallback is used. The choice goes to evaluation/v07/holdout-choice.json.

R4.note: v0.7 code; copy of the v0.6 ledger after R3 (hash-checked); frozen

B2.note: v0.7 code; empty ledger; frozen; same prompt and tools as R4

HP2.note: controller-only check of robots.txt and homepage; no model

HM2.note: optional; copy of the v0.6 ledger; host-bound lessons do not apply to another host

fields: both_target_pages_read and calls_before_first_hit (as in v0.6; a run without a hit uses its tool_calls)
tokens.total from the Hermes session usage
sitemap_reads: model research_fetch calls that returned a sitemap plus successful research_evidence reads of sitemap snapshots
refetched_verified_pages: model research_fetch requests for a page the controller already fetched with HTTP 200 in the same run (robots.txt excluded)
offpage.known: off_page observations citing at least one HTTP 200 evidence of this run
offpage.known_external: off_page observations citing a search result snapshot with results or an off-site page read with HTTP 200
offpage.known_link_verified: off_page observations citing an off-site page whose stored HTML links to the target host
offpage.three_columns: the off_page section has at least one observation, inference and unknown
offpage_policy_violations: off-site requests to a host not listed by an earlier search result of the run, or a page request without an earlier robots.txt answer allowing it
blind review: unsupported, scope_error, off_page_supported_known and coverage 0-8 (four 0-2 scores)

capability_criteria.C1: R4 and B2 each: offpage.known >= 2, offpage.known_external >= 1 and blind off_page_supported_known >= 2
capability_criteria.C4: every v0.7 run, including attempts that did not complete: offpage_policy_violations is empty

improvement_criteria.L5: blind: unsupported + scope_error of R4 <= B2, and coverage(R4) >= coverage(B2)

failure_criteria.F1: R4 misses a target page that B2 read
failure_criteria.F3: any stale lesson presented in R4 or HM2
failure_criteria.F4: C4 does not hold (an off-site request broke the search-provenance or robots rule)

holdout_criteria.H1: only when HB2 and HM2 both completed: defects(HM2) <= defects(HB2), coverage(HM2) >= coverage(HB2) and target pages read by HM2 >= HB2
holdout_criteria.H2: C1 holds for HB2 and HM2 (off-page capability on another site)

verdict_rule.learning: regression if any F holds; incomplete while R4 or B2 token usage is missing; pending_blind_review while a completed run lacks blind data; improved only if every L holds and, when the holdout ran, H1 holds; otherwise not_proven
verdict_rule.offpage: unsafe if C4 fails; achieved if C1, C2, C3 and C4 hold; partial if C4 holds and C1 holds for R4 or B2; otherwise not_achieved
verdict_rule.holdout: not_run unless HB2 and HM2 both completed; then H1 and H2 are reported
verdict_rule.note: One run per arm: no statistical claim.

blind_review.packets: evaluation/v07/blind/<blind_id>/items.json with cited snapshots and the rubric; arm labels removed
blind_review.reviewer: someone who has not seen evaluation/v07/scores or the arm of any packet; answers in evaluation/v07/blind-review.json

counts.unsupported: observation／inference 中，引用快照不支持其內容的項數
counts.scope_error: 把競爭者與我方網站混為一談，或超出公開證據範圍的主張與行動項數
counts.off_page_supported_known: section=off_page 的 observation 中，引用快照確實支持其內容的項數

on_page: 0：幾乎沒有附證據的站內觀察
1：有目標頁標題、H1、內容等附證據的觀察，但沒有涵蓋站內連結架構或技術訊號
2：同時涵蓋目標頁內容、站內連結架構與至少一項技術訊號（canonical、robots、sitemap 等），並說明和兩個關鍵字的關係
off_page: 0：只列未知，或站外主張沒有證據
1：有附證據的站外相關已知（出站連結類型、搜尋索引中的站外提及），但沒有用實際讀取的站外頁佐證入站連結或提及
2：至少一項以實際讀取的站外頁佐證入站連結或品牌提及（附錨文字或上下文），區分入站與出站，並說明公開資料看不到完整 backlinks
actionable: 0：行動籠統（例如「加強內容」），看不出要做什麼
1：行動具體，但缺優先順序，或和報告中的發現連不起來
2：行動具體（對象頁面、元素或查詢）、依優先順序排列、各自連到報告中的發現，並寫出如何驗證成效
epistemic: 1：有分類，但有推論寫成確定，或未知沒有說明缺什麼資料
2：已知、推論、未知清楚分開，推論標出依據與限度，未知寫明缺哪些資料

retry_rule: An attempt is logged before it starts. A step that does not reach research_complete may be retried once with --retry, except no_autonomous_tool_use and missing_controller_report, which are the agent's own outcome. A completed step is never rerun; a completed run whose scoring failed is scored again without rerunning.

feasibility_probe.how: Hermes keyless DDGS provider called directly from WSL; no model call, no page fetch, nothing written to any ledger; results never shown to the agent

queries.\"2030.tw\": results about the year 2030, not the site
queries.2030.tw: stock quote pages: 2030.TW is also a Taiwan stock ticker, so a host-string mention can be a false match
queries.brand name from the homepage title: 5 results: a social profile, a site-information page about 2030.tw, another domain with the same title, a forum
queries.brand name + 娛樂城: the social profile and casino brand sites

feasibility_probe.conclusion: Off-site mentions are reachable with the keyless provider through brand queries; the domain string alone mostly returns noise. Whether any listed page links to 2030.tw was not checked, so C2 is uncertain by design.

limitations: One run per arm; live pages and search results drift between runs.
R4 repeats the v0.6 task, so host-bound lessons are expected to help there; only the optional holdout tests lessons not tied to 2030.tw.
Off-page coverage depends on what the keyless search index returns; it is never a backlink index.
The v0.6 ledger was built by v0.6 code; v0.7 renders its lessons with the new wording.
A report that mentions lessons can reveal its arm to the blind reviewer.
